response.sql: WITH excluded AS (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `U-PRO` = '-'), patient_stats AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.ALP * 1.0 / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID NOT IN (SELECT ID FROM excluded) GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '') AS sex, AVG(ps.avg_pt) AS avg_pt, AVG(ps.avg_ratio) AS avg_alp_gpt_ratio FROM patient_stats ps JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = ps.ID GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.SEX), ''), '')
